title: Hunter Green: Your Carbon Offset Contribution
summary: Explains how Hunter Green carbon offset contributions are calculated: 18.0% of your monthly maintenance fee is directed to third-party verified carbon offset programs, and 3 trees are sponsored for every $10,000 in average monthly balance. It also covers how to maximize impact (higher balance, account in good standing) and where to view results (statements and sustainability materials showing 18.0% and tree counts).
